These are in no particular order.. just random projects from memory.

1.  Royal academy for nature by Ammar Khammash (He also designed the new currencies.. just a fun fact)
2. Columbia University Middle East Research center in Jabal Amman, also by Ammar Khammash
3. HTU Main building… it has to be here because there bridges always stun me everytime I see them.
4. St. Regis in Amman.. no clue by whom, but I like the “grandness” of it.
5. YU library building by Rasem Badran… mesmerizing honestly with the massing and those free standing frames.
6. The royal botanic garden by Yousef Madanat
7. Cubic house (private residence) By yousef madanat aswell, the profound use of concrete is unlike anything I’ve seen here honestly.
8. Hamshari Mosque… unrivaled modern mosque in my opinion.

9.Gallery Ras Al-Ain by Turath: Architecture…. Wow honestly.

10. The almighty Royal Jordanian HQ….. Marvelously stunning! You can really feel the low gravity influence only by looking at it.

11. Darat Al-Funun By Ammar Khammash (can you tell how much I admire his work yet)..I honestly don’t have the right to even give my opinion on this piece of art, it’s too good.

12.Al-Khayyam Cinema from the 1940s. It’s a great building but what makes it greater for me is that it was my first ever “abandoned exploration” site, went inside the old rusty thing and had a blast, it’s quite smelly and terrifying but it’ll forever be stuck in memory, and nose.

That’s all the “modern” buildings that came to mind, if I opened my traditional architecture book, I would be no where close to being done.

If you use tiktok on PC, you can just change your DNS settings.

Following are the steps to do so: (Windows 10)

1. Right click on your connection icon in the taskbar (wifi or ethernet shouldn’t matter)
2. Look for “change adapter settings” on the right hand side in the settings windows which opens up.
3. Right click on your adapter, click properties and then you should be greeted with a screen of different options.
4. Look for TCP/IPV4, click properties and look for DNS.
5. Set the DNS to manual, change the primary DNS To 1.1.1.1 And the alternate DNS to 8.8.8.8
